* '''Original''' ([[A Power Loss]], 22 June 2021): Original: the image at the set's official release (23 June 2021). Players Committee card image, 22 June 2021: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-apowerloss-20210622.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/a_power_loss.png Holotable commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images”], no mark). Text: “Deploy on Central Core. Leia may not modify Force drains. Once per game, opponent may stack up to two cards from hand face-down here. Allow The Ship To Leave: If you just won a battle at a Death Star site (or initiated a Force drain here), place a card stacked here in owner's Lost Pile. That Old Man Did It!: If you occupy this site and another Death Star site while no cards stacked here, power 'shut down' (place this card out of play; your movement between Death Star locations is free this turn).”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 20 April 2022): Players Committee card image, 20 April 2022: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-apowerloss-20220420.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2640d50/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/apowerloss.png Holotable commit 2640d50 “Set 18 and errata”], no mark). Text: “Deploy on Central Core. Leia may not modify Force drains. Once per game, opponent may stack up to two cards from hand face-down here. Allow The Ship To Leave: If you just won a battle at a Death Star site (or initiated a Force drain here), place a card stacked here in owner's Lost Pile. That Old Man Did It!: If you occupy this site and another Death Star site while no cards stacked here, power 'shut down' (place this card out of play; your movement between Death Star locations is free this turn).” '''What changed:''' the card was re-rendered at a higher resolution (745×1039, was 703×980); the words are unchanged. Every published image that differs from the previous one is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026: “A change is a change is a change”).
*: [[File:V15-L-apowerloss-20220420-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[A Power Loss (Errata 2)]], 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V15-L-apowerloss.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/apowerloss.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “Deploy on Central Core. Once per game, opponent may stack up to two cards from hand face-down here. All This Sneaking Around: Path Of Least Resistance is canceled. While no cards stacked here, Leia moves using landspeed for free. Allow The Ship To Leave: If you just won a battle at a Death Star site (or initiated a Force drain here), place a card stacked here in owner's Lost Pile. That Old Man Did It!: If you occupy this site and another Death Star site while no cards stacked here, for remainder of game, power 'shut down.'” '''What changed:''' “Leia may not modify Force drains.” is gone; new: “All This Sneaking Around: Path Of Least Resistance is canceled. While no cards stacked here, Leia moves using landspeed for free.”; “power 'shut down' (place this card out of play; your movement between Death Star locations is free this turn)” became “for remainder of game, power 'shut down.'”; the card prints the errata mark “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
